personality_one_liner: A highly structured, data-driven, and authoritative iOS-native experience that balances professional exam preparation with motivating, tactile gamification.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding between sections to avoid cognitive overload. Tight spacing inside data cards. Use flex grid to evenly space metric tiles.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar so scrolling lists flow smoothly behind.
Use glass on sticky headers in the question bank.
Use glass for the bottom action container in the Flashcard view.
dont's: Never use glass on data cards or metric tiles.
Never blur body text or question explanations.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A dashboard combining gamification streaks, overall readiness score, and quick entry points to study modes.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for progress rings and metric cards.
states.empty: Onboarding prompt: 'Define your target exam to generate your daily plan.'
states.error: Failed to load progress. Retry button.

screens.layout: Header: User greeting + Streak counter (warning color for fire). Section 1: Hero readiness card (progress ring for % of preparation, hours studied). Section 2: 2-column grid of quick metrics (Questions answered, Accuracy %). Section 3: Horizontal scroll of primary actions (Estudar, Simulado, Flashcards, Chat IA) inside tinted containers. Section 4: Daily goal progress.

screens.name: Questões (Question Bank)
screens.purpose: A highly readable, distraction-free interface for solving multiple-choice questions.
screens.layout: Sticky glass header with active filters (Subject, Year). Question text in textFontFamily (Geist) at base size. Options stacked vertically as touchable cards (border selection). Primary sticky CTA at bottom: 'Responder'. Upon answering, card expands inline to show AI explanation.

screens.name: Flashcards
screens.purpose: Spaced-repetition review session with smooth swipe and tap animations.

states.empty: 'Success Favours The Prepared' empty state illustration. 'You have completed all reviews for today!'

screens.layout: Centered main card. Tap to flip (Reanimated). Once flipped, 4 pill buttons appear anchored at bottom: 'Não Lembro' (error tint), 'Difícil' (warning tint), 'Lembrei' (brandPrimary tint), 'Fácil' (brandSecondary tint). No complex desktop UI; just the card and 4 actions.

screens.name: Chat IA (Professor IA)
screens.purpose: Interactive chat with the AI tutor for personalized explanations.

states.empty: Suggested prompts as chips: 'Explain Administrative Law', 'How to study for INSS?'

screens.layout: Scrollable chat timeline. User messages align right (brandPrimary bubble). AI messages align left (surfaceSecondary bubble) with the AI avatar image on the side. Sticky input at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

hero_study.alt: Desk with notebook and pen, representing study planning

empty_success.alt: Scrabble tiles saying Success Favours The Prepared

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 'iOS-Native Clean' personality. The UI must feel like a serious, professional tool. Avoid playful/bouncy elements outside of gamification milestones.
Color Palette Constraint: ALL BLUES AND PURPLES ARE STRICTLY BANNED. Use the provided Forest Green/Emerald brand colors. Gamification streaks should utilize the warning (Ochre) token.

Typography: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and numbers on the dashboard. Use Geist for body text, question descriptions, and all long-form reading content. Geist provides excellent legibility for dense study materials.

Dashboard Layout: Ensure the metric grid uses standard React Native Flexbox (`flexDirection: 'row'`, `flexWrap: 'wrap'`, `justifyContent: 'space-between'`, `gap: md`). Avoid 'orphaned' cards on the right side.

Flashcards Implementation: Replace complex Anki properties with a fluid mobile experience. Use `react-native-reanimated` for smooth card flipping. The four response buttons MUST be anchored at the bottom (sticky inside a safe area container).
Gamification Components: Implement a visual 'StreakBadge' component using `warning` text and a Phosphor Fire icon. The Home dashboard should have a progress ring for the daily goal.
Images: Always apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (as defined in the system rules) when placing text over the 'hero_study' background image.
